column1: # "6. The view document"): the figures a document declares as data,
# drawn from ONE evaluation of it, all or nothing.
# Four columns: name, views, src, expect. The options ride
# `expect.ask` -- `views` names the path of the map that declares the
# figures, which is the AUTHOR's key and not the engine's (ADR-010).
# The rest of `expect` is the report: {verdict, views} where each entry
# is {name, kind, out, verdict, text, loss} on a drawn figure and
# {name, kind, out, verdict, errors, loss: []} on a refused one, each
# error minus its prose. A fault in the DECLARATIONS is the set's own
# {verdict: error, views: [], errors} and no figures at all.
#   the figures drawn in the order the declaration keys sort, whatever
#   order the document writes them in; the declaration keys being the
#   library's option names (the flag names without the dashes); `kind`
#   and `out` required of every declaration; a profile the kind cannot
#   render refused before anything is drawn; the poset refused, because
#   a view document declares figures of the ONE document it includes;
#   every value's shape (text, whole count, flag, list of strings);
#   a fault in one declaration not stopping the others being reported;
#   a figure that REFUSES leaving the set in error with the figures
#   that drew still carrying their bytes, so a reader sees what the
#   run did; the panels that need their own instrumented run (layers)
#   or a re-run of `why` (ladder) drawing the same bytes they draw
#   alone; and a document that does not stand up or does not generate
